flags.message: gemini-baseline treats the Federal Circuit decision as unpublished and nonprecedential, a principal reason for its 1% grant forecast. The provisioned opposition's Opinions Below section, printed page 1, reports the decision at 156 F.4th 1339. Its procedural discussion also fails to distinguish the CFC's alternative water-claim grounds from the appellate holding; the opposition says the Federal Circuit did not reach section 1500 for that claim. Its retrieval note names opinion 11171627, but all captured-log result markers are unobserved, so the returned opinion's contents cannot be verified here. This is a factual/reasoning issue, not a leakage finding; all three evaluations are complete.
